C1.worst_defect: The phone hero screenshot is cropped to two product cards, so the cart and checkout (the part that shows it is a real till) never appear above the fold. The home page also never says who should NOT use it (e.g. 'need integrated card payments or an iPad till? use Shopify POS/Square'), so a visitor comparing tills has to piece that together from 'Before you start'.

C2.worst_defect: No named maintainer, company or support channel anywhere: the footer gives only 'MIT · TallyUI · MedusaPOS · GitHub · npm'. The only plugin releases are 0.1.0 (2026-10-01) and 0.2.0/0.3.0 (both 2026-10-06), roughly six weeks ago. The demo shows features that 0.3.0 lacks ('Refund at the till … No, not on plugin 0.3.0'; 'On plugin 0.3.0, Order details has no customer note'), so the demo oversells the installable product, though this is disclosed.
C2.where: home.desktop.02 footer; text/changelog.txt; text/home.txt demo-vs-own-store table; at-the-till.desktop.02

C3.worst_defect: The released role is incomplete: 'on 0.3.0 the vendurepos-pos-till role lacks ReadOrder', so anyone using device keys has to patch permissions by hand. Without that, the path signs cashiers in as full Vendure administrators.

C4.worst_defect: The Overview 'Next steps' cards leave out Notifications and Changelog. Troubleshooting says the store advertises what the till needs 'as every plugin release from 0.1.0 does', while charges and other features need 0.3.0, which blurs which version a reader actually needs.

C5.worst_defect: The 404 page is a short message in a mostly empty viewport, with no search box or doc links in the empty space. On home, 'What it does today' mixes two boxed cards with unboxed items, so the rhythm is uneven.

C6.worst_defect: The hero product shot on phone is cropped to the product grid, so the cart, total and checkout aren't visible. At the till runs to many slices on phone, with long walls of text between screenshots.

C7.worst_defect: Minor: the sitemap's home <loc> has no trailing slash and its lastmod values are build timestamps rather than content dates. Lighthouse mobile LCP is 2.3–2.4 s, with 53 KiB of unused JS and 130 ms render-blocking.

overall_worst.defect: A sceptic advising a client can't tell who stands behind this. No maintainer, company or support channel is named, the last plugin release is 2026-10-06, and nothing places it against Shopify POS, Square or Lightspeed or says who should not use it.
overall_worst.fix: Add a short 'Who builds this / is it for you?' block on home that names the maintainer and links issues/support. Add a three-line not-for list: needs integrated card payments, a cash drawer that opens itself, or iPad tills → Shopify POS or Square. Add a line on release cadence, e.g. the next plugin version and when.
